data.one_liner: A custom sliding segmented control widget with flexible configuration and animations.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to build and customize a sliding segmented control widget with configurable colors, animation duration, curves, sizes, and initial values. It supports custom decorations for both the main panel and the sliding thumb.
use_when: You need a custom segmented control with smooth sliding animations between options.
You want to style both the background container and the active segment thumb independently using BoxDecoration.
avoid_when: You require standard platform-native segmented controls without custom styling.
You need complex navigation routing tied directly to the tabs.
strengths: Highly configurable decorations for both container and thumb
Supports custom animation curves and durations
Dynamic initial values and size calculations on orientation change
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced properties beyond the basic README example
Relies entirely on custom UI implementation rather than native look-and-feel bindings
